user.title: Empreinte
user.description: Choose the sensor that gives the **total power of the house** in watts: a Linky meter (ZLinky, Lixee, TIC…), a Shelly EM, a clamp meter… Empreinte works on this single curve; nothing leaves your Home Assistant.

data_description.power_entity: Live total power (W) of the whole house, updated every few seconds.

error.not_found: This sensor does not exist or is not available yet.

init.title: Empreinte settings
init.description: All optional. Leave a field empty if it does not apply to your home.

data.measured: Smart plugs that already measure a device

data_description.measured: Their power is subtracted before the analysis (PC, TV…), so these devices are never mistaken for something else.
data_description.climate_entity: While it runs, its compressor makes the curve go up and down: Empreinte ignores these small steps instead of inventing appliances.
data_description.climate_energy: Its own kWh meter, if it has one: it gets its own line in the daily balance.
data_description.fridge_kwh_year: kWh per year, from its energy label. Too small to be seen on the curve, it is estimated and taken out of « unidentified ». 0 = not estimated.
data_description.extra_lines: For example Powercalc meters (lights, internet box, alarm): taken out of « unidentified » in the balance, never added to the Energy dashboard.
